paper.purpose: Professional page ground (--color-paper); scrollbar track, trail dots.

paper-2.purpose: Professional panels, stage, nav pill, buttons (--color-paper-2).

paper-3.purpose: Professional deepest step: footer, image wells, hover fill (--color-paper-3).

ink-2.purpose: Professional secondary text, organisation names, hover borders (--color-ink-2).

muted.purpose: Professional body-secondary text, labels, nav links at rest (--color-muted).

rule.purpose: Professional every 1px hairline and the hero ruled-paper grid (--color-rule).

rule-2.purpose: Professional outlines, timeline spine, scrollbar thumb, ruler ticks (--color-rule-2).

amber.purpose: Professional person and main action: Email me, progress line, focus, current job border (--color-accent, --color-focus).

amber-hover.purpose: Professional primary button hover and scrollbar active (--color-accent-hover).

amber-soft.purpose: Professional current menu item and Current chip fill (--color-accent-soft).

amber-text.purpose: Professional accent text on hover: links, mode button, footer links (--color-accent-text).

cool.purpose: Professional what a system measured: timeline dates (--color-cool). Never swapped with amber.

bad.purpose: Professional error state token (--color-bad); defined, not shown in the page.

graphite-2.purpose: Creative panels, nav pill, buttons, work list (--color-paper-2).

graphite-3.purpose: Creative footer, image wells, hover fill (--color-paper-3).

amber-lit.purpose: Creative person and main action; progress line, focus, avatar disc, pupils' ring (--color-accent).

amber-lit-soft.purpose: Creative current menu item and Current chip fill (--color-accent-soft).

display.purpose: Hero h1 only: Host Grotesk 500, --text-display clamp(2.75rem, 5vw + 1rem, 5.25rem), tracking -0.03em, line-height 1.05, max 8ch in hero.

display-small.purpose: --text-display-s clamp(2.25rem, 4vw + 0.5rem, 3.75rem); the 404 and compact display uses.

section.purpose: h2 section titles: 500, --text-section clamp(2rem, 2.5vw + 1rem, 3.5rem), max 30ch, balanced.

title.purpose: h3 and work-row titles: --text-title clamp(1.25rem, 0.75vw + 0.875rem, 1.625rem), line-height 1.2; row titles 600; trail and index h3 at --text-lg 1.25rem.

lead.purpose: One-sentence pitch and Let's talk line: --text-lead clamp(1.125rem, 0.35vw + 1rem, 1.375rem), line-height 1.45, max 52ch (28ch in hero).

body.purpose: Host Grotesk 400 (350 in Creative), 1rem, line-height 1.55, paragraphs max 65ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, chips, picker tabs, footer titles: body face at 0.875rem (chips 0.8125rem), weight 500, sentence case, no tracking, never all-caps.

reading.purpose: System-written text only, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 400: the Let's talk email at clamp(1.25rem, 7.4vw, 4.25rem), tracking -0.04em, tabular slashed-zero; timeline dates and footer year at 0.875rem.

motion.name: dur-short
motion.purpose: Every colour, border, background and arrow transition (--dur-short).

motion.name: mode-rise
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: on mode switch everything on screen rises in (hero-rise, set by mode.js). Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: photo-flip
motion.purpose: Creative portrait turns to the 3D avatar (hover, tap on phones).

motion.name: pupil-follow
motion.purpose: Creative eyes follow the cursor on the gaze-tracking thumbnail.

motion.name: backdrop-in
motion.purpose: Creative skyline canvas fades in after the switch.

motion.name: progress-line
motion.purpose: 3px amber line at the window top, driven by progress.js from scroll position.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Nav links become a second tab pill; hero, record and skills stack; index rows single column; gutter 24px.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 16px, column gap 16px, smaller section gaps.

narrative.overview:
Console, in two colourways. Professional (default) is light paper; Creative (opt-in, data-mode="creative") is dark graphite with a Kathmandu skyline canvas behind the hero. Same layout, same roles, different values. One page, index-first: hero, Projects, Experience beside Education, Skills, Let's talk, footer.

Amber marks the person and the one main action. Cool blue marks what a system measured: dates and the selected screenshot tab. Host Grotesk carries everything a person reads; Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono carries only what a system writes. Depth is lightness and 1px rules; the page chrome has no shadows, glows or gradients.

The skyline (Three.js, src/scripts/skyline.js) is an illustration inside its own canvas and is not part of the token system. The Professional hero keeps a ruled-paper band (32px grid, tick ruler) the same height as Creative's skyline band, so switching modes never shifts the page.
keyCharacteristics: Two colourways filling the same roles: paper (light, default) and graphite (dark, opt-in).
Amber for the person and main action; blue for measured facts; never swapped, no third signal colour.
Host Grotesk 400/500 for reading, headings 500 at -0.03em tracking; Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono only for system-written text.
Panels: 1px rule, paper-2 fill, 10px corners; 6px on controls, 4px on chips; adjacent panels are one surface split by 1px seams.
No shadows in page chrome; colour and border changes over 220ms, one authored entrance on mode switch.
Floating pill nav, 3px amber scroll progress line, themed thin scrollbar that warms to amber on hover.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Amber is the person and the one main action (Email me, the current job, the current menu item, focus). Cool blue is what a system measured (dates, the selected screenshot tab). Never swap them, never add a third signal colour.

rules.name: The Same Roles Rule
rules.body: Both modes fill the same roles (paper, ink, rule, accent, cool, ok), so every component works in either. Creative changes values, never components.

rules.name: The System Writes Mono Rule
rules.body: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is only for what a system writes: timeline dates, the email address in Let's talk, the year in the footer. Never on a label, heading or button.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, chips and footer titles are the body face a step smaller, in sentence case. No all-caps.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows or gradients in the page chrome. Elevation is lightness only. The one exception is the Creative skyline, an illustration inside its own canvas.

rules.name: The One Surface Rule
rules.body: Panels that sit together are one surface split by 1px seams (the project index, the skills), not separate cards with gaps.

dos: Do fill the shared roles (paper, paper-2, paper-3, ink, rule, accent, cool) so a component works in both modes without extra rules.
Do use amber only for the person and the one main action; use cool blue only for what a system measured.
Do set headings in Host Grotesk 500 with -0.03em tracking, never bold.
Do keep buttons 48px tall (44px small) with icon plus label: amber fill for the main action, hairline outline for the rest.
Do keep the hero's bottom padding at clamp(8rem, 21vh, 13rem) in both modes.
Do stop all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't swap amber and blue, or add a third signal colour.
Don't use the mono face on labels, headings or buttons.
Don't add shadows, glows or gradients to page chrome, hover lifts, parallax or scroll reveals.
Don't treat the skyline canvas as part of the token system or reuse its dusk glow in the page.
